newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia PSC to operate shipyard in Ghana.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia PSC to operate shipyard in Ghana.

text.p: PSC Industries Bhd said on Wednesday that its 70-percent-owned subsidiary, Penang Shipbuilding & Construction Sdn Bhd, has entered into a joint venture with the Ghanaian government to acquire, manage and operate a shipyard in Ghana.

It said in a statement that Penang Shipbuilding will acquire 60 percent of the joint-venture company, PSC Tema Shipyard Ltd, for 10.9 million ringgit ($4.3 million) in cash while the remaining 40 percent is to be acquired by the Ghanaian government for 7.0 million ringgit.

PSC Tema will provide an estimated 13.25 million ringgit to rehabilitate Tema Shipyard & Drydock Co Ltd (TSDC) which provides services for shipbuilding and repairs, and is engaged in the construction and fabrication of steel structures.
The statement said PSC and the Ghanaian government wanted to promote the business of PSC Tema in order to obtain a listing of the joint-venture company on the Ghana Stock Exchange within five years.
